## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_STAGE2_GRINDER candidate aims to capture the edge in trading SNIPER LEVEL BREAK + VIX>=18 + VIX-trend regime filter. This hypothesis is based on the idea that the VIX trend can be used as a filter to improve the performance of the SNIPER LEVEL BREAK strategy.

## Mechanism

The SNIPER_STAGE2_GRINDER candidate uses the following mechanism:
- SNIPER LEVEL BREAK: This is the core strategy that looks for level breaks in the SPY.
- VIX>=18: This filter is used to only consider trades when the VIX is above 18.
- VIX-trend regime filter: This filter is used to only consider trades when the VIX is in an escalating trend.
